strings.drivers.hint.tdengine: Uses the taosAdapter REST interface, default port 6041.
strings.drivers.hint.elasticsearch: Database is the index name. REST document browsing is limited to the first 10,000 results.
strings.drivers.oracle_client_required: Oracle requires an x64 Oracle Client. Install it or place Instant Client files in drivers/native/oracle.
strings.drivers.removed: This driver has been removed. The saved connection is preserved; select a supported Rust adapter or delete the connection.
